name: ag-ui
description: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
one_liner: A standard 'plug' that lets any AI agent connect cleanly to any website or app's front end, so developers don't have to custom-build that connection every time.
buyer: No direct buyer — this is open infrastructure for developers, not a product end-users or businesses pay for directly.
business_use_cases: A startup building an AI-powered app front end uses the protocol so they can swap in different AI agent backends without rewriting their UI.
A platform vendor adopts the protocol as a selling point — 'works with any AG-UI compatible agent' — reducing integration friction for customers.
A consultancy builds client-specific agent-to-frontend integrations faster by starting from this standard instead of a one-off custom build.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid integration consulting helping companies adopt the protocol and wire their existing AI agents into their product's UI

steal_this: Honestly, this is foundational developer plumbing with no direct consumer angle — the real business is integration services built on top, not the protocol itself.
